proposedManifest.name: Blood Hunt
proposedManifest.description: A shroud of darkness cuts Earth off from the sun, and vampires step out of hiding to strike across the world. The Avengers are among their first targets. For Doctor Strange, Miles Morales and the people caught in the streets, there's no waiting for morning. Someone has to bring the daylight back.
